translationRepairs: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.
Yelü Chun — his regime is known as Northern Liao.
世號為北遼 names the polity by which the age knew Yelü Chun, not his lifespan; “regime” correctly replaces the false “age” reading while keeping the rest of the sentence.
Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).
Yelü Dashi — his regime is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).
Parallel 世號為西遼 likewise designates the Western Liao polity, not a lifespan label; “regime” fixes the same mistranslation of 世號.
Chancellor Li Chuwen and others secretly admitted Song troops; residents responded from within, and gate guards were killed in great numbers.
Chancellor Li Chun and others secretly admitted Song troops; residents responded from within, and gate guards were killed in great numbers.
宰相李純 is Li Chun; “Chuwen” invents syllables absent from 李純. The proposed name matches the Chinese and the already-extracted personal-name claim.
At age seven he wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
At age seven, [the court] wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
七歲，欲立為皇太子 has no subject that is Yali; the wishing is impersonal/court action. Supplying [the court] corrects the false agent without altering the rest of the literal wording.
